name: sova-chat
description: Self-hosted customer support with a website widget, Android SDK, AI assistant, and operator inbox

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sova/shared && npm run build -w @sova/server && npm run build -w @sova/widget && npm run build -w @sova/panel
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @sova/shared && npm run build -w @sova/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sova/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sova/server && npm run typecheck -w @sova/widget && npm run typecheck -w @sova/panel
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sova/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,panel,widget -c green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:panel" "npm:dev:widget"
